verdict.rationale: Stable's own API documents searching and retrieving MailItems, and each item carries scan data: an image URL, OCR result URLs and a summary. That gives a programmatic way to pull scans and mail metadata out of the platform, but there is no documented bulk or one-click export feature, so the operator would have to script retrieval item by item. missing for 10: a dedicated bulk export of scans as PDFs plus mail history, a documented export format or archive download, an account-exit or data-portability workflow, and independent corroboration that scan files can be retrieved at scale.
